## THE JOB
An intel card for the map screen: an evocative, useful blurb for one landmark
of the arena. Players read it in the seconds before a match.

## THE LANDMARK — `The Core`
The level designer's notes, verbatim from the arena manifest:
Central structure, the map's centerpiece and primary sightline-breaker, restructured in v3 so the Rocket Launcher pad is buildable at MID level per GDD 2.6. Base drum x[16,24] y[16,24] z[0,4] is solid; its roof at height 4 is the mid-level rocket terrace and rocket_node (20,17,4) stands on its south side. Spire x[18,22] y[18,22] z[4,9] rises from the roof center, breaking the mid-level north-south line; its flat top at height 9 is a grapple perch (Core Top, GP5/GP6). Four full-height corner pylons x[15,17] y[15,17] z[0,9], x[23,25] y[15,17] z[0,9], x[15,17] y[23,25] z[0,9], x[23,25] y[23,25] z[0,9] carry the diagonal occlusion between mid and upper spawns; they deliberately embed 1 m into the base drum's corners (union geometry).

Write the card: at most 2 sentences. Return JSON only:
{"card": "..."}

response.card: Rocket terrace crowns the mid drum, and the spire above breaks the line north-south while its flat top holds the Core Top grapple perch. Corner pylons carve the last diagonal sightlines between mid and upper spawns.
